title: GMRT bathymetry grid row
description: One row from a GMRT GridServer ESRI ASCII Grid response. Each row carries the row index within the requested bounding box and the serialised string of elevations for that row (space-separated; metres above the WGS-84 ellipsoid; negative for below sea level).

row_index.description: 0-based row index within the requested bounding box.

elevation_string.description: Space-separated elevation values for this row (metres). Parsed lazily by downstream consumers to avoid per-cell row inflation in the NDJSON file.
